Leah (Docs): Heads-up: product wants a concise migration playbook for v1->v2 (invoke/generate). Need a 1-pager + three snippets (cURL, JS shim, Python) and a short support checklist by Thu EOD.

Tom (Eng): Ok. Main breaking changes: `model_id` renamed to `model`; `input` replaced by `messages` array; streaming events now use `delta` instead of `token`. We added `X-Compat-Mode: v1` header for a limited opt-in.

Riya (SE): For Dedicated customers, remind them to update any firewall rules for the new path `/v2/*`. Also include a small routing config example to flip traffic to v2 with canary.

Leah (Docs): Can someone paste minimal before/after cURL and a tiny shim?

Tom (Eng): Old cURL:
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/invoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model_id":"rwd-base","input":"Summarize this"}'
New cURL:
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v2/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rwd-base-2","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize this"}]}'

Tiny JS shim (server-side):
function shim(p){ if(p.model_id) return {model: p.model_id + '-2', messages:[{role:'user', content: p.input||''}]}; return p }

Leah (Docs): Great. Maya, can you draft 2-3 canned support replies?

Maya (Support): Yes. Short one: "If you see 410 on POST, check if you're on a pinned SDK or private deployment; try adding header X-Compat-Mode: v1 as a temporary workaround and contact support for migration help." Will add escalation steps for high-risk customers.

Olga (Ops): Note on logs: compat header will be retained for 30 days; we can redact on request. Also ops-runbook will include rollback steps for routing flips.

Leah (Docs): I'll assemble the one-pager and open a draft PR. DocsBot: please create draft link when PR is open.

DocsBot: PR created -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2999 (migration-playbook/v1-to-v2)

Leah (Docs): Timeline: reviews by Wed EOD (eng/security/ops/support). Publish Fri morning with staged outbound comms. Thanks everyone.
